VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: SELF

The acceptance criteria explicitly requires that "all 58 tests pass," which is a verifiable, objective requirement. The only evidence provided is a self-report with no attached CI logs, test results, diffs, or independent artifacts to corroborate the claim. A self-report alone cannot satisfy acceptance criteria that demand demonstrable proof of test passage. The agent's description of the fix may be technically sound, but without independent verification (CI logs, test output, or code review), the acceptance criteria cannot be confirmed as met.
